item.text: Для 6.3 добавлю invite model/repository с opaque hash-only token, expiry и atomic consume. Реализую invite creation для участника организации, authenticated accept с проверкой email и одноразовым membership creation, а также member list только при membership в том же `orgID`. Ownership/RBAC checks следующих задач не добавляю.

item.aggregated_output:
mux := http.NewServeMux()
	application := &App{
		Config:             cfg,
		Clock:              deps.Clock,
		IDGenerator:        deps.IDGenerator,
		Users:              deps.Users,
		Sessions:           deps.Sessions,
		PasswordResets:     deps.PasswordResets,
		EmailVerifications: deps.EmailVerifications,
		Organizations:      deps.Organizations,
		Memberships:        deps.Memberships,
		Invites:             deps.Invites,
		AccessToken:        deps.AccessToken,
		LoginGuard:         deps.LoginGuard,
		handler:            httpapi.LimitJSONBody(mux),
	}
	mux.HandleFunc("/v1/register", application.register)
	mux.HandleFunc("/v1/login", application.login)
	mux.HandleFunc("/v1/token/refresh", application.refresh)
	mux.Handle("/v1/me", httpapi.BearerMiddleware(application.AccessToken, http.HandlerFunc(application.me)))
	mux.Handle("/v1/logout", httpapi.BearerMiddleware(application.AccessToken, http.HandlerFunc(application.logout)))
	mux.Handle("/v1/logout-all", httpapi.BearerMiddleware(application.AccessToken, http.HandlerFunc(application.logoutAll)))
	mux.Handle("/v1/sessions", httpapi.BearerMiddleware(application.AccessToken, http.HandlerFunc(application.sessions)))
	mux.Handle("/v1/sessions/", httpapi.BearerMiddleware(application.AccessToken, http.HandlerFunc(application.sessionByID)))
	mux.Handle("/v1/password/change", httpapi.BearerMiddleware(application.AccessToken, http.HandlerFunc(application.passwordChange)))
	mux.HandleFunc("/v1/password-reset/request", application.passwordResetRequest)
	mux.HandleFunc("/v1/password-reset/confirm", application.passwordResetConfirm)
	mux.Handle("/v1/email-verification/request", httpapi.BearerMiddleware(application.AccessToken, http.HandlerFunc(application.emailVerificationRequest)))
	mux.HandleFunc("/v1/email-verification/confirm", application.emailVerificationConfirm)
	mux.Handle("/v1/organizations", httpapi.BearerMiddleware(application.AccessToken, http.HandlerFunc(application.organizations)))
	return application, nil
}

// Handler returns the application's HTTP handler.
func (a *App) Handler() http.Handler { return a.handler }
